failed.description: Whether the row reports a failure.

id.description: The job id, or the directory name when the directory cannot be read.

progress.description: `<runs ended>/<runs started>`, `?` when the event log cannot be read.

spec.description: The digest of the job's spec, or `-` when it cannot be read.

what.description:
What the job runs: `experiment:<12 hex of the experiment digest>`, `suite:<file name>`, or
`-` when the job has no readable spec file.

description: The jobs of a store and the state of each: what `candler ps` prints.

jobs.description: One row per job directory, in the order of their names.

schema.description: The version marker of the document: always `job-list/1`.

store.description: The root of the store the jobs were read from.

title: JobList
